spans.s:
(ई) नृती r. 4th cl. (नृत्यति)
To dance, to dance as an actor, to gesticulate, to act.

n. (-त्तं)
Dancing.
E.
नृत to dance, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
Dancing, the science or practice.
E.
नृत to dance, aff. कि.

m. (-तूः)
1 A dancer, a mime, an actor.
2

A worm.
4 Length.
E.
नृत to dance, and कू aff.

n. (-त्यं)
Dancing, acting, the actor's practice in general.
E.
नृत to dance, aff. क्यप्.

mfn. (-त्यन्-त्यन्ती-त्यत्)
Dancing.
E.
नृत to dance, शतृ aff.
